QuestInfo.name: [Princess No] Wills of the Five Planets
QuestInfo.0: What message are the planets trying to send to Princess Sakuno? Talk to #p9130104:# to find out.
QuestInfo.1: Maple World and Zipangu are unable to coexist because Oda Nobunaga and Princess No's attempts to move across the dimensions disrupted the balance of worlds. To stop this, Princess No must be stopped. The will of the five planets will deliver a grace to each Job that aids in defeating Princess No.
